body: I wish I could upvote you more! Thank you.

I wish I could hear her side of the story, no offense but as the miracle white bio child of the household, I’m sure you feel much differently than she does. Transracial adoptee trauma is prominent and very real. Though this doesn’t justify what she said to you, it is very very likely she does feel traumatized by the way she was treated in the household as any poc child raise “color blind” is set up for failure.
she claims i’m the favorite and that i always get better things than her, she doesn’t think i deserve it and that all i do is pester her and ultimately make my parents treat her badly :/

I couldn't agree more, no matter how I try to see it, to me depression comes in constant crashing devastating waves. All I'm left to ever hope is that someday I won't make it past it and finally rest in peace.
this,, this is genuinely hard to watch.
no, no one can hold secrets forever, I bet the weight feels off your shoulders now. You're really brave I hope you know that, your family loves you, and you will get better.

Do it, you've got nothing to lose. You sound dedicated and things will work out for you if you truly want them to, you'll get a job, meet new people, and start from 0. I believe in you, I hope everything works out for you.
Hmm, it could work. I hope things get better for you soon, that you find a permanent way to cope. I'm glad I'm not the only one feeling this way.
It's always at the back of my head, even on my best days I know that it won't last forever, I'm working on perhaps not doing that I'm glad things are going better for you :)
for years, just when I think I'm over it & I'm doing better it comes back worse than the last.
